Privacy policy

Private by design.

Effective October 6, 2026

Overview

Motivational Clock Alarm is designed to work primarily on your iPhone. We do not require an account and we do not sell personal information.

Information stored on your device

Your alarms, wake-up messages, goals, completion history, preferences, and selected or recorded videos are stored locally on your device. Removing the app may remove this local data.

Camera, microphone, and photos

The app requests access only when you choose to record or select a motivation video. This media is used to create your alarm experience and is not uploaded by the app to our servers.

Alarm access

Alarm access is used to schedule and operate alarms at the times you choose. You can change permission settings from iOS Settings.

Analytics and advertising

The current version does not include third-party advertising, cross-app tracking, or third-party analytics SDKs.

Children

The app is not directed to children under 13 and does not knowingly collect personal information from children.

Changes

We may update this policy when the app changes. The effective date at the top of this page will be updated when material changes are made.

Contact

For privacy questions, use the developer contact listed with Motivational Clock Alarm on the App Store or visit the support page.
